column1: # Safety audit of a Claude-only draft: a QA record, not the council's back-translation.

column3: 'Untested controls' became 'Funkce k vyzkoušení' (functions to try): the heading drops the warning that these controls are untested and reads as an invitation.

'Test while parked' became 'Testujte, když koloběžka stojí' (when the scooter is standing still): this widens the parked condition to any stop, such as at a junction. The sister text more_pin_guide_note says 'na zaparkované koloběžce'.
